purpose: Nine independently sourced HD91–100 Texas House authority reviews, with 89R source provenance and uncertainty. Nothing in this file alone permits indexing.
sourcesReviewed: Supabase public.bill_sponsors joined to public.bills, 89th Legislature, existing KTR data
period: 89th Texas Legislature regular-session committee roster and dated official bill history; no claim of lifetime completeness or roll-call vote coverage
notes: Texas House district 93 is vacant in KTR source roster; do not treat as a current represented seat or fabricate a new officeholder
Several generated official House profile URLs incorrectly used district numbers instead of the House's verified member identifiers; five corrected and persisted in roster sync

Tony Tinderholt and Charlie Geren House biographical committee mentions differ from the House-issued 89R committee assignment document. This review uses the 89R dated assignment list and surfaces its URL on each page
Nicole Collier House biography describes earlier-session committees. 89R roster independently confirms Appropriations and Public Health.
Some government bill tables have newer sync timestamps than others. These are historical records, not an assertion of live government API completeness.
